format: little-endian float32, row major, south to north then west to east

fittedAgainst.note: derived from Sentinel-2 and rescaled to measured depths. Not a survey: a derived seabed with a known error rather than an unknown one.

landRestored.why: fit-depths applies its linear fit to every cell, land included; the island (nir > 0.03 in the scene, written as +0.6 m by get-reef) came out 4.6 m underwater. Land cells are put back at their get-reef height; the fit is unchanged everywhere the satellite saw bottom.
